# Indian Invention Boy

> Indian Invention Boy sells gold and silver home décor: figurines, vases, flower stands and silver serving trays. Every piece is listed with its price in Indian Rupees (₹). Enquiries are handled on WhatsApp.

## Core Information
- **Brand Name**: Indian Invention Boy
- **Currency**: Indian Rupees (INR, ₹)
- **Enquiries**: WhatsApp, +91 63966 39864
- **Collections**: Figurines; Vases & Stands; Serving Trays
- **Catalogue size**: 6 pieces
